title: Changelog Pagination, Payment Hardening & SQL Report Aggregation
summary: Paginated platform changelog releases five versions per page; tightened payment callbacks and transaction IDs; aggregated tenant financial reports in PostgreSQL; and enforced deployment JWT and stub-gateway guardrails.

changes.text: Payment webhooks rely on attempt state for idempotency; tenant webhook receipts record only after verified success

changes.text: Stub payment gateway blocked in staging and production; JWT access and refresh secrets must be distinct and at least 32 characters on deploy
